description: This file defines the McpOAuthService class which manages OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, including token handling, client registration, token refresh, and server discovery for MCP servers within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: McpOAuthService
classes.description: Main class handling OAuth 2.0 authorization flows, token storage, refresh, and client registration for MCP servers.

methods.name: initiateOAuthFlow
methods.description: Starts the OAuth authorization code flow, including discovery, PKCE, client registration, and token exchange.

methods.name: getStoredTokens
methods.description: Retrieves stored OAuth tokens for a server if available.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes stored tokens for a server, used for logout or re-authentication.

methods.name: clearClientCredentials
methods.description: Deletes stored client credentials for a specific authorization server.

methods.name: clearAllClientCredentials
methods.description: Deletes stored client credentials for all known servers.

methods.name: checkTokenRefreshNeeded
methods.description: Checks if the current access token is expired or about to expire and needs refresh.

methods.name: getTokenDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debug info about stored token data for a server.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Uses the refresh token to obtain a new access token.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Performs Dynamic Client Registration with the authorization server.

methods.name: getOrRegisterClient
methods.description: Retrieves existing client credentials or performs registration if needed.

methods.name: areRedirectUrisEqual
methods.description: Checks if two redirect URI lists are equivalent.

methods.name: probeServerForAuthHeader
methods.description: Probes the server to retrieve the WWW-Authenticate header from a 401 response.

methods.name: exchangeCodeForToken
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: hashUrl
methods.description: Generates a hash string from a URL for storage key purposes.
